answer: Bind each agent identity to a ferrous hardware root: one TPM-style key fused into a single physical machine, so one device holds exactly one identity. Onboarding presents a signed marble of device measurements — firmware hash, boot chain, timing fingerprint — that the network verifies before issuing credentials. A clone reusing the same key is caught instantly; swapping keys forces a fresh, costly onboarding. Like a spiral staircase, reputation climbs one narrow step at a time: a sybil army cannot copy its way up, it must buy a whole new machine for every fake voice.
